item.title: StartLux-Decision v1.1 Tops Decision Index 0.3.2 With Open Models That Think Only When Unsure
item.description: StartLux's 27B Instant model leads the community-run Decision Index 0.3.2 with a Full score of 69.12. The family spans eight open models from 0.8B to 27B under a non-commercial license.

item.title: Tencent's Marvis AI Butler Lands in the Kylin Software Store With Support for Domestic CPUs
item.description: Marvis now installs on Kylin Desktop OS V10 SP1 for x86 and ARM, can call Kylin's security and system tools, and is open to government, state-owned and industry partners.

item.title: Tencent Launches Free WorkBuddy Education Edition With 2,000 Monthly Credits for Every Teacher
item.description: Tencent SSV's free WorkBuddy edition gives teachers 12 months of credits, 100-plus expert skills built with Peking University and Beijing Normal University, and five classroom tools.

item.title: AgiBot's Lingxi X2 Handles 46,686 Patient Queries at Peking University People's Hospital Front Desk
item.description: Running Ant Group's Afu medical assistant, the half-size humanoid worked 66 days at an outpatient help desk, averaging about 707 interactions a day and peaking at 1,420.

item.title: X Square Robot Launches X2Real, an Evolving Simulation Benchmark It Says Tracks Real-Robot Results
item.description: X2Real calibrates simulated robots against real hardware, spans 44 tasks in 10 categories, and uses AI agents to write new tests. The company reports 0.96 sim-to-real success correlation.
